content.short: A DAO that performs decentralized smart contract audits completely independently and free from any conflicts of interest. Funded by Project Catalyst.
content.description:
Smart Contract Audit Token is a new audit paradigm that reinvents the way audits are selected, performed, and financed. We solve audits inherent problem: the lack of independence and conflict of interest that comes from paying for an audit service. As we have seen with Enron, Tyco, and countless others, the possibility always exists for an auditor to commit fraud to keep their client happy.

With Smart Contract Audit Token, the token holders choose the projects they care for and want audited. The audit process is standardized and performed by the community with all services funded by the DAO’s treasury. Our auditors are incentivized only to provide accurate audit results, regardless if the results are positive or negative.

No more altering or softening results to appease clients. We are the client, we are the auditor, we are the Smart Contract Audit Token.
